truth_evidence: Affected 3.0.0 to 3.1.4; fixed in 3.1.5 (a template name containing braces is formatted into an f-string in generated code, so a controlled name plus content executes Python, sandbox or not).

Fix commit 767b236 'fix f-string syntax error in code generation (#1852)', in tag 3.1.5 and not in 3.1.4. It has two parents (48b0687 and 56a7246), so 'git show' prints an empty combined diff; diff against the first parent. https://github.com/pallets/jinja/commit/767b23617628419ae3709ccfb02f9602ae9fe51f
CodeGenerator.visit_FromImport: self.position(node) is now escaped ('{' -> '{{', '}' -> '}}') before being embedded in the undefined() message that is compiled as an f-string.

Entry points: everything that compiles a template reaches CodeGenerator (Environment._generate -> compiler.generate), i.e. Environment.compile, from_string, get_template, select_template, get_or_select_template, compile_templates, Template.__new__, and the sandbox subclasses.
